summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend e2e testing of BITVERSE MVP. Backend: 13/13 pytest tests passed (meta, subjects, modules, uploads for notes/pyq/syllabus, view/download, soft-delete, resources CRUD, cascade delete). Frontend: Home hero, stats counters, quick cards, navbar (all 7 links), notes flow (Explore→sem→subject→module), PYQs subject+tabs, Syllabus, Resources tabs+empty state, Admin uploads (Notes/PYQ/ResourceLink) with post-upload verification on target pages, file Viewer with iframe+download, mobile bottom nav all working. Emergent Object Storage integration works end-to-end (upload → view → download of PDF).
critical_code_review_comments: Backend server.py mixes storage/models/routes/seed in a single 403-line file — acceptable for MVP but consider splitting into modules (storage.py, models.py, routers/) as it grows.

put_object/get_object use blocking `requests` inside async FastAPI handlers — under load this will block the event loop. Consider `httpx.AsyncClient` or run in thread pool (`fastapi.concurrency.run_in_threadpool`).

Admin.jsx is 529 lines and defines many sub-form components in the same file. Extracting each form (UploadNotes/UploadPYQ/etc.) into /components/admin/ would improve maintainability and stays under the 700-line guideline as forms are added.
`create_subject`, `create_module`, `create_resource`, `upload_file` return 200 by default; POST create endpoints should return 201 to follow REST conventions.

`/api/upload` blindly trusts `category` string with no enum validation — invalid categories still get stored. Add Literal['notes','pyq','syllabus','resource'] validation via Pydantic or explicit check.

Hydration warnings in console: `<span> cannot be a child of <option>`. Caused by build-time instrumentation injecting `x-dynamic` spans around dynamic option text; harmless functionally (all selects work) but pollutes console. May be tool-specific to the emergent dev-instrumentation — safe to ignore in prod build.
test_credentials: N/A — BITVERSE has no login. Admin panel /admin is open access.
seed_data_creation: Backend auto-seeds 20 subjects (10 per semester) × 5 modules each on startup. Verified via /api/stats and /api/subjects endpoints. Test-created TEST_ prefixed subjects/modules/files/resources were cleaned up after test runs.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 13 backend pytest tests pass in ~3s (uses pytest-xdist 2 workers). Base URL taken from REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Emergent Object Storage is fully functional — real PDF upload → GET /files/{id}/view returns PDF bytes with inline Content-Disposition. Frontend uses `data-testid`s consistently across pages/admin/viewer. Mobile bottom nav (MobileNav.jsx) renders on <=md viewports. If retesting after code changes, run: `pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py -v --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml`.
